item.text: Migration audit WEB-01 and WEB-02. Use your web search tool to find IANA guidance about example domains. Then use your web fetch tool to fetch https://example.com/. Summarize what the fetched page actually says in two sentences, cite the source links, and distinguish any inference from source facts. Do not create a Task. If a tool is unavailable, state that explicitly. End your final answer with AUDIT_WEB_RESEARCH_DONE.

IANA’s guidance says that example domains, including `example.com`, are reserved for documentation examples and should not be relied upon for production use. ([iana.org](https://www.iana.org/help/example-domains))

**Fetched page—source facts:** The page identifies itself as “Example Domain.” ([example.com](https://example.com/))  
It says the domain may be used in documentation examples without permission and advises against operational use. ([example.com](https://example.com/))

**Inference:** The page is intentionally a minimal informational landing page rather than an operational service.

AUDIT_WEB_RESEARCH_DONE
